mapper.select: SELECT A.CODE_NO, S.CONTENT FROM SY_CODE A JOIN SY_CODE_PARAM P ON P.CODE_NO = A.CODE_NO AND P.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} LEFT JOIN SY_GLOBAL_NAME S ON S.NO = A.CODE_NO AND S.LANGUAGE = #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE A.ACTIVITY = 1 AND (A.PARENT_CODE_NO IN (21, 31) OR (A.PARENT_CODE_NO = #{parentCodeNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND P.ACTIVITY = 1 AND A.CODE_NO NOT IN (21, 31))) ORDER BY CASE WHEN A.PARENT_CODE_NO IN (21, 31) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, A.PARENT_CODE_NO, A.ORDERNO

SELECT C.AFFIRM_OBJECT, C.OBJECT_CODE, C.OBJECT_NAME, C.OBJECT_TYPE FROM (SELECT E.PERSON_ID AS AFFIRM_OBJECT, E.EMPID AS OBJECT_CODE, E.LOCAL_NAME AS OBJECT_NAME, 'E' AS OBJECT_TYPE FROM HR_EMPLOYEE E JOIN SY_AFFIRM_RELATION_SPECIAL T ON T.AFFIRM_OBJECT = E.PERSON_ID WHERE T.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} UNION SELECT D.DEPTNO AS AFFIRM_OBJECT, D.DEPTID AS OBJECT_CODE, GET_DEPT_NAME(D.DEPTNO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS OBJECT_NAME, 'D' AS OBJECT_TYPE FROM HR_DEPARTMENT D JOIN SY_AFFIRM_RELATION_SPECIAL T ON T.AFFIRM_OBJECT = D.DEPTNO WHERE D.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND T.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) C
(UPPER(C.OBJECT_CODE) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) || '%' OR C.AFFIRM_OBJECT LIKE '%' || #{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' OR CONVERTTOUNSIGN(UPPER(C.OBJECT_NAME)) LIKE '%' || CONVERTTOUNSIGN(UPPER(#{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR})) || '%')
ORDER BY C.OBJECT_TYPE DESC, C.OBJECT_CODE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SY_AFFIRM_RELATION_SPECIAL (AFFIRM_RELATION_NO, CPNY_ID, AFFIRMOR_ID, AFFIRM_TYPE_ID, AFFIRM_LEVEL, AFFIRM_OBJECT, ACTIVITY, CREATE_DATE, CREATED_BY) VALUES (SY_AFFIRM_RELATION_SPECIAL_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{affirmorId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{affirmTypeNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{affirmLevel, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{affirmObject, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 1, SYSDATE, #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR})
